class.name: OcgTDFTool
class.brief_description: This class provides general services for a data framework.
class.description: ! This class provides general services for a data framework.

method.name: NbLabels
method.description: Returns the number of labels of the tree, including <aLabel>. aLabel is also included in this figure. This information is useful in setting the size of an array.

method.name: NbAttributes_1
method.description: Returns the total number of attributes attached to the labels dependent on the label aLabel. The attributes of aLabel are also included in this figure. This information is useful in setting the size of an array.

method.name: NbAttributes_2
method.description: Returns the number of attributes of the tree, selected by a<Filter>, including those of <aLabel>.

method.name: IsSelfContained_1
method.description: Returns true if <aLabel> and its descendants reference only attributes or labels attached to themselves.

method.name: IsSelfContained_2
method.description: Returns true if <aLabel> and its descendants reference only attributes or labels attached to themselves and kept by <aFilter>.

method.name: RelocateLabel
method.description: Returns the label having the same sub-entry as <aLabel> but located as descendant as <toRoot> instead of <fromRoot>.

method.name: Entry
method.description: Returns the entry for the label aLabel in the form of the ASCII character string anEntry containing the tag list for aLabel.

method.name: TagList_1
method.description: Returns the entry of <aLabel> as list of integers in <aTagList>.

method.name: TagList_2
method.description: Returns the entry expressed by <anEntry> as list of integers in <aTagList>.

method.name: Label_1
method.description: Returns the label expressed by <anEntry>; creates the label if it does not exist and if <create> is true.

method.name: Label_2
method.description: Returns the label expressed by <anEntry>; creates the label if it does not exist and if <create> is true.

method.name: Label_3
method.description: Returns the label expressed by <anEntry>; creates the label if it does not exist and if <create> is true.

method.name: DeepDump_1
method.description: Dumps <aDF> and its labels and their attributes.

method.name: ExtendedDeepDump_1
method.description: Dumps <aDF> and its labels and their attributes, if their IDs are kept by <aFilter>. Dumps also the attributes content.

method.name: DeepDump_2
method.description: Dumps <aLabel>, its children and their attributes.

method.name: ExtendedDeepDump_2
method.description: Dumps <aLabel>, its children and their attributes, if their IDs are kept by <aFilter>. Dumps also the attributes content.
